indicator_name: National Fund receipts: additional payment of subsoil users under production-sharing contracts, year-to-date, monthly
description: Дополнительный платёж недропользователя по СРП (поступления в Национальный фонд), нарастающим итогом с начала года, помесячно
methodology: Million KZT (source: thousand KZT), National Fund of the Republic of Kazakhstan, additional payment of subsoil users under production-sharing contracts, YEAR-TO-DATE cumulative (January to the month dated): the report 'as of 1 <month>' is dated the month before, 'as of 1 January' is December. From every Minfin 'Statement of receipts and application of the National Fund' in the listing (106 of 106 parsed; the approved annual reports for 2018 and 2024 stand in for the missing reports as of 1 January 2019 and 2025; the latest posting wins, 1 revised point(s) across the series). Every report passes seven taxes = direct taxes on the oil sector. History: KGD has no month before Minfin's first. Months no report covers are missing, not interpolated.
